curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can two adoptive brothers stay ahead of agents and mercenaries seeking an otherworldly weapon?
curatedMovie.description: After discovering an otherworldly weapon, a young boy uses it to protect his adoptive older brother from criminals, inadvertently drawing the crosshairs of federal agents and relentless mercenaries.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and suspenseful sci-fi chase with moderate emotional weight and engaged focus.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A boy’s otherworldly weapon sends him and his adoptive older brother on the run from federal agents and mercenaries.
